finish.summary: Placed all six boxes on their designated platforms with bottom faces supported (y=1.56 for Platform1, y=2.24 for Platform2). Box3 and Box6 are fully contained in their slots. However, Box1, Box2, Box4, and Box5 exceed their narrow slot X-bounds because their lengths along X (1.25, 1.18, 1.3, 1.2) are larger than the slot widths (0.64, 0.64, 0.64, 0.64), making full containment impossible without rotation that would violate facing constraints or other bounds. Facing was set to yaw=180 for most boxes to point local +Z toward -Z where Aim markers are located.
